blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Japanese electronics manufacturer Toshiba Corp. plans to expand its hard disk drive (HDD) manufacturing operations in the Philippines, a move that could create 3,000 additional jobs, according to Malacañang. On Saturday, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said in a statement that the Marcos administration expressed support for the expansion in a meeting with Toshiba senior executive vice president Koji Ikeya at Malacañang on Thursday.
